'''The Cage''' is the 40th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on June 21, 2019. The set consists of 63 cards. This set is part of the current ''The Original Series Block'', consisting of cards from [[The Cage (expansion)|The Cage]], [[The Neutral Zone (expansion)|The Neutral Zone]], and [[A Private Little War (expansion)|A Private Little War]] expansion sets.
